description: Registered commands on the machine that holds the dedicated checkouts (one per repo, <root>/<owner>/<name>, used by nothing else): fetch and reset bring a checkout's local main to origin/main before an associate run (an earlier run's local merge is discarded; its change is already in a configuration PR), and pause is the poll interval of the run-status loop (a retry_until body has no wait step). Commands run with argv lists, never a shell, in a temporary directory with only PATH and LANG set, so the remote must be fetchable without HOME (for example https for a public repo); otherwise prefix the fetch argv with env HOME=<the node user's home>.
name: Qodo improvement checkout
